I have farmed maize here in Mbeya for many years, and the soil is good when I add manure from my cattle and one bag of urea from the shop. I will plant improved seed because it grows strong in our rains, but maize does not need spray and we have no irrigation water on this plot. My family will work the land with hoes, though I will pay a few young men to help with the heavy clearing at the start.
